notes.title: Update 1.2.4 - Improved Combat AI
notes.notes:
DevLog 1.2.4

NEW FEATURES/IMPROVEMENTS:

• New enemy added: Yellow Slime , which is a lightning elemental that can do an AOE damage and fires a lightning projectile
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32934301/7a91010325cd9d3135a8a2e4ad60d69ce0286488.gif

•  Combat AI has been overhauled all across the board, and is prepped for new boss fights, and enemy types
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32934301/2b5dce389f303d57e660bfa9b85c823c81b550a3.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32934301/32c466c73bc4aff5f2e489078212b00c4d86d142.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32934301/3c17c6fec9a74e2647274bedc0b690c61e820e9e.gif

• Party Units while engaged in battle & there's an obstacle in between them and an enemy – will now pathfind to the enemy

• Ninja Warrior Party Units attack animation's have been improved

• Attack wind effect (trail renderer) for melee attacks has been improved

• Party units will now move randomly out of the way of player when in combat

• The timing for enemies/party units that fire projectiles has been greatly adjusted so the animation and projectiles are better synced

BUG FIXES:

• Fixed an issue where the combat system had some "break-points" for the enemy and the party (This is a complex thing to explain but the gist is they behave much better in multiple combat situations now)

• The formation/regroup will now work for all party units

notes.title: Update 1.2.3 - Pathfinding
notes.notes:
DevLog 1.2.3:

NEW FEATURES:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32934301/a4028c310eb448536af081bc04530b7a2a53ed47.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32934301/01f812db2d8dc41856b5e7d99af54a9c616a4296.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32934301/4092d2b8569122fb0ba840b08e9759dd8082f37d.gif

• Pathfinding added to the Party Units, when they go off screen they will pathfind to the player. Also auto teleporting to player is moved out a bit further as well to accommodate

• Formation/Regroup added to the party menu

• Introducing a new puzzle system starting with a tile-based puzzle that's easy to solve in the Ninja cave

•  New enemy variants for the vampire bat and spider have been added in the Ninja cave, this will make the grind a bit smoother in the Ninja prologue

BUG FIXES/IMPROVEMENTS:

• Major fix where if you disabled the torch it would break map transitions

• Major fix for if you tried to talk to the dead clan leader the dialogue would freeze

• Ninja boss fight in cave has been improved with new animations and effects

• Ninja sword attack effects improved

notes.title: Update 1.2.2 - More bug fixes
notes.notes:
DevLog 1.2.2:

BUG FIXES:

• Fixes to the tutorial system so it no longer conflicts with NPC dialogue, disables any nearby enemies, and closes off other maps until finished.

• Fixes to the way the Party Units move away from you on touch, they now properly animate when moving away from you and no longer look like a floating mannequin.

• Party Unit NPC's combat mode adjusted a bit so they should go after enemies a bit more and not stop as much

IMPROVEMENTS:

• Player mass is raised to 20 to make sure NPC's don't move the player around too aggressively

notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
DevLog Update 1.2.1

IMPROVEMENTS:

• Ninja Power Bow and Arrow Animations finalized (for the most part)
• Loot notification container is now located in the bottom left corner of screen.
• Inventory now closes all tabs when you press escape or B on controller

BUG FIXES:

• Map transitions now force the player to stop moving and disables pause at all transitions points now
• Fixed an issue where when leaving some areas of the Overworld map you wouldn't be able to pause
• Fixed a major issue where after attacking in any given direction then opening inventory would make the player attack in the last direction moved in inventory
• Fixed an issue with the Ninja prologue quest when you go to talk with wise master the items he gives you would magnet to you before dialogue was closed

notes.title: News about Update 1.1.7
notes.notes:
Here is the change log for upcoming update 1.1.7.

We decided to focus on some of bug fixes that were reported by a player HERE: https://steamcommunity.com/app/873050/discussions/0/3158631000002656665/
The Ninja class quest can now be continued after fixing the Wise Master not having a dialogue trigger. The Druid can walk around in the Druid starter area much easier now. The Dark Knight starter chest now has more potions and a campfire to help the lowers levels. Read more below:

BUG FIXES:


 Stamina fix, when your character hits 10 or less stamina a timer kicks in after 4 seconds to regen +7 stamina for 2 seconds to ensure you don't die as easily
 The Ninja class quest can now be continued after fixing the Wise Master not having a dialogue trigger
 The Druid can walk around in the Druid starter area much easier now, the Sabertooth Lyger will always spawn behind the Druid
 The Dark Knight starter chest now has more potions and a campfire to help the lowers levels

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Crescent Hollow - Update 1.1.1

Early Access update 1.1.1 contains more much needed improvements and bug fixes. We would’ve liked to have more content in this update but polish takes precedent. Version 1.1.2 should be the mega update with tons of new content, and pushes the main story forward.

NEW FEATURES:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32934301/a058b698a38f808f4f81c22065aea0f9cb5f8a44.gif
• Druid Shape-Shifting added, wolf is the first power for now (Wolf gives a +3 Agility (Movement Speed), and +3 Strength (Damage). You can do a melee attack with the wolf

BIG FIXES/IMPROVEMENTS:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32934301/2b9553351e7191904f3d602bfe2daaa6397c5c89.gif

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32934301/6c3e367b678d05832b826e20c5d3cd11677e9daa.gif
• Wolf, Bat, and Spider animations have been improved

• Harvesting animations fixes for all classes

• You can now left-click to attack, and right click to toggle the mouse cursor

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32934301/ee847c439e1eaffcbc1411e1d0062b3ef4463fdb.gif
• Enemies, party units, and the player now highlight properly when attacked

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32934301/b7af5e7c1c0a00f92b9ba497c21e71f97be63554.gif
• Dialogue system revamped (new dialogue system back in-game)

• Ninja starter zone improved with new animations

• Fixes to the toggle utilities menu button (Tab)

• Ninja combat effects improved

• Major prep work for the next big content update which should be in the next update – 1.1.2
